title: Create an episode
story: As a creator, I want to create a Veronica episode with a working title and production defaults so that I can start from a canonical revision.

title: Clone an episode safely
story: As a creator, I want to clone a prior episode as a new draft so that I can reuse structure without mutating the original.

title: Version episode changes
story: As a creator, I want material edits to create a new production revision so that approved history remains auditable.

title: Archive an episode
story: As a creator, I want to archive an episode without deleting its lineage so that inactive work is removed from normal queues.

title: Apply versioned genre defaults
story: As the production system, I want every run to capture the effective Veronica genre configuration so that output is reproducible.

title: Upload mixed source assets
story: As a creator, I want to attach PDFs, slide decks, documents, images, and screenshots so that the episode can be source-driven.

title: Deduplicate identical sources
story: As the system, I want identical source content deduplicated so that extraction and storage are not repeated.

title: Extract source structure
story: As the system, I want to extract page/slide/text/media structure so that downstream agents can reason about source material.

title: Classify source usage policy
story: As a creator, I want to mark assets as mandatory, optional, context-only, or forbidden-for-display so that the agent respects editorial constraints.

title: Reuse prior extraction
story: As the system, I want unchanged source extraction reused so that repeated runs do not incur duplicate processing.

title: Track source-to-output lineage
story: As a reviewer, I want to see which source items influenced narration and visuals so that I can audit the episode.

title: Generate episode outline
story: As a creator, I want an outline derived from the episode and sources so that the story has a coherent structure.

title: Generate duration-bounded narration
story: As a creator, I want narration targeted to the requested duration so that the render fits the intended format.

title: Adapt source wording
story: As a creator, I want the agent to adapt and reorganize supplied wording so that the episode is coherent rather than a verbatim slideshow.

title: Produce TTS-safe narration
story: As the system, I want a clean spoken script so that TTS does not read markdown headings or production metadata.

title: Edit narration manually
story: As an editor, I want to edit narration and preserve the diff so that human corrections remain auditable.

title: Freeze narration for production
story: As an editor, I want to approve/freeze narration so that expensive downstream work uses stable inputs.

title: Derive scene visual plan
story: As the production system, I want a scene-level visual plan aligned to narration so that assets and timing are coherent.

title: Prefer relevant source media
story: As a creator, I want supplied media reused when it fits so that original material is preserved and generation cost is reduced.

title: Redesign source slides
story: As a creator, I want source slides to be redesigned when needed for clarity so that they work as video visuals.

title: Derive camera/image direction once
story: As the system, I want episode-level camera/image direction derived from relevant context and cached so that image generation remains coherent and does not repeat expensive analysis.

title: Attach reference images only when relevant
story: As the system, I want reference images attached only to visual prompts that require them so that prompts remain efficient and semantically focused.

title: Support heterogeneous visual types
story: As a creator, I want the plan to mix source visuals, generated imagery, diagrams, typography, and redesigned slides so that episodes avoid repetitive visual treatment.

title: Review visual plan before generation
story: As an editor, I want to review the visual plan before expensive generation so that obvious mistakes are caught cheaply.

title: Create 16:9 composition
story: As a creator, I want a 16:9 edition so that the episode is suitable for standard YouTube viewing.

title: Create 9:16 composition
story: As a creator, I want a 9:16 edition so that the same episode can produce vertical content.

title: Share semantic content across formats
story: As the system, I want both aspect ratios linked to the same semantic revision so that format derivatives do not diverge editorially.

title: Validate mobile readability
story: As a reviewer, I want vertical text/safe-area validation so that 9:16 output is usable on phones.

title: Create a localized edition
story: As a creator, I want to localize an approved episode into another language so that I can publish the same content internationally.

title: Translate narration contextually
story: As a localization reviewer, I want narration translated for natural target-language delivery so that it does not sound mechanically literal.

title: Translate embedded text
story: As a viewer, I want meaningful on-screen text in my language so that localized videos are fully understandable.

title: Reuse language-independent images
story: As a creator, I want language-independent images reused across locales so that localization does not pay for image regeneration.

title: Regenerate only inseparable localized visuals
story: As the system, I want a visual regenerated only when language is inseparably embedded or layout cannot be safely recomposed so that cost remains bounded.

title: Localize metadata and captions
story: As a creator, I want titles, descriptions, captions, chapters, and other publishable metadata localized with the episode.

title: Review localization deltas
story: As a localization reviewer, I want a delta-focused review so that I do not re-review unchanged imagery.

title: Generate TTS audio
story: As a creator, I want TTS generated from the approved spoken script so that narration can be rendered automatically.

title: Configure voice per genre/language
story: As an administrator, I want genre and language voice defaults with overrides so that production remains consistent.

title: Generate synchronized captions
story: As a viewer, I want captions synchronized to narration so that the video is accessible and usable without audio.

title: Replace TTS without rebuilding visuals
story: As a creator, I want to change voice/audio without regenerating unaffected images so that voice iteration is cheap.

title: Generate approval pack
story: As a reviewer, I want a self-contained approval pack so that I can evaluate an episode without inspecting internal runtime state.

title: Approve a production revision
story: As a reviewer, I want to approve an exact revision so that only reviewed artifacts can progress.

title: Reject a specific artifact
story: As a reviewer, I want to reject a scene, translation, audio track, or other bounded artifact so that remediation can stay narrow.

title: Compare revisions
story: As a reviewer, I want to compare previous and remediated revisions so that I can focus on actual changes.

title: Audit approvals and configuration
story: As an administrator, I want approval/configuration history so that production decisions can be reconstructed.

title: Compute typed invalidation
story: As the system, I want dependency-aware invalidation so that only affected artifacts are regenerated.

title: Cache expensive provider outputs
story: As the system, I want compatible LLM/image/TTS results cached so that retries and regeneration do not repeat cost-bearing work.

title: Make mutations idempotent
story: As an API consumer, I want retriable mutations to be idempotent so that network retries do not duplicate jobs or artifacts.

title: Resume from first stale stage
story: As an operator, I want a failed or changed run to resume from the earliest affected dependency so that prior valid work is preserved.

title: Explain reuse vs regeneration
story: As a reviewer, I want to know why each artifact was reused or regenerated so that I can trust caching behavior.

title: Queue bulk episode production
story: As an operator, I want to submit many episodes for production so that campaigns can be produced efficiently.

title: Preflight a batch
story: As an operator, I want credentials, quotas, policy, and source requirements checked before a batch starts so that predictable failures happen cheaply.

title: Bound production concurrency
story: As an administrator, I want stage/provider concurrency limits so that bulk production does not overload infrastructure or rate limits.

title: Retry failed batch items independently
story: As an operator, I want failed episode/stage items retried independently so that successful work is not repeated.

title: Generate aggregate approval pack
story: As a reviewer, I want an aggregate pack across episodes so that bulk review is efficient without hiding per-episode findings.

title: Render with FFmpeg pipeline
story: As an operator, I want approved assets rendered through the FFmpeg-based renderer so that outputs are reproducible.

title: Render per format and locale
story: As an operator, I want format/locale outputs rendered independently so that one failed derivative does not block all editions.

title: Produce delivery bundle
story: As a creator, I want a downloadable delivery bundle so that I can publish outside the automated integration if needed.

title: Generate render previews
story: As a reviewer, I want low-cost previews before final delivery so that layout/timing defects are caught earlier.

title: Generate publishing metadata
story: As a creator, I want titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, and related metadata generated from the approved episode so that publishing is efficient.

title: Preflight publishing
story: As an operator, I want publishing requirements validated before upload so that incomplete/unauthorized releases fail closed.

title: Publish an approved edition
story: As a creator, I want to publish an exact approved edition so that released content matches review.

title: Schedule publication
story: As a creator, I want to schedule an approved edition so that release timing can be planned.

title: Create episode via API
story: As an API consumer, I want to create an episode through a typed versioned contract so that workflows can be automated.

title: Start production via API
story: As an API consumer, I want to start production idempotently so that orchestration is reliable.

title: Observe run status via API
story: As an API consumer, I want stage-level status and failure details so that external systems can react.

title: Approve or reject via API
story: As an authorized reviewer integration, I want to approve/reject exact revisions so that governance is available without UI-only workflows.

title: Receive production events
story: As an API consumer, I want webhook/event notifications for meaningful lifecycle changes so that polling can be minimized.

title: Enforce tenant isolation
story: As an administrator, I want strict tenant isolation across sources, artifacts, credentials, logs, and jobs so that SaaS data cannot cross boundaries.

title: Classify operational failures
story: As an operator, I want failures categorized so that I know whether to retry, reconfigure, or edit input.

title: Retry transient failures safely
story: As the system, I want bounded retries with backoff so that transient provider faults recover without duplicate work.

title: Use configured provider fallback
story: As an administrator, I want compatible fallback providers so that production can continue during outages when explicitly allowed.

title: Expose production metrics
story: As an operator, I want stage latency, failures, queue depth, retries, cache hits, and provider usage metrics so that the pipeline can be operated reliably.

title: Correlate logs across a run
story: As an operator, I want correlation IDs across episode/run/stage/provider calls so that incidents can be traced.

title: Link analytics to production revision
story: As a creator, I want performance metrics linked to the exact published revision so that I know what creative produced the result.

title: Compare formats and locales
story: As a creator, I want to compare 16:9/9:16 and localized editions so that I can decide where to invest production effort.

title: Fork from a successful pattern
story: As a creator, I want to create a new episode/revision from a high-performing pattern so that successful structures can be reused deliberately.

title: Configure providers
story: As an administrator, I want provider credentials and defaults configured centrally so that production behavior is controlled.

title: Configure cost budgets
story: As an administrator, I want cost ceilings and paid-step policies so that agentic production cannot spend without bounds.

title: Configure approval policies
story: As an administrator, I want approval gates configurable by stage/risk so that production can balance autonomy and control.

title: Configure feature flags
story: As an administrator, I want new production features gated so that they can be rolled out safely.

title: Fail closed on missing required configuration
story: As an operator, I want production preflight to fail closed when required credentials/configuration are missing so that the system does not enter a partially invalid run.
